application.backendVersion: reviewed DXMT bcdcf6d with original default-off timing hook

dependency.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later; original helper Apache-2.0; combined distribution review open

limitations: Generated offscreen native D3D11 only; no Windows workload, Start-menu cost, actual GPU utilization, physical scanout, game FPS or120Hz qualification.

Default-off baseline uses the same hook source before numeric-byte and atomic-output helper refinements; those helpers are excluded when the build option is off. Not an isolated causal regression experiment.
Execution spans can include GPU waits and overlapping commands, and exclude other command queues and readback; their sum is not hardware utilization.
One MiB output and32768 records are per-process limits; combined live VM logging and profiler overhead remain unqualified.
Initial linker/configuration failures and earlier profiler iterations retained privately; final actual native checks pass.
ASAN/UBSAN cover original CPU/output and source-ordering fixtures; the complete DXMT library was a release build.
Ten sequential alternating pairs on an interactive host, fixed case order, uncontrolled startup/cache/power/thermal state; no confidence interval or speedup claim.
No release distribution, signing/notarization or license clearance follows from local component signatures and hashes.
Host identity fields reused from the same-host DXMT fixture; dynamic storage free space collected afresh.

method.outlierPolicy: two declared warmup pairs retained in configuration; all ten subsequent alternating pairs retained; no outlier removal
method.backgroundWorkload: Live Windows VM and interactive development host; no build/observer/profiler during a trial except the selected native timing variant; load, power and thermal state uncontrolled
